description: Rebuild a PDF keeping only the pages you list, in the order you list them. Reordering, deleting and duplicating are all the same operation: a page you omit is dropped, a page you move is reordered, and a page listed twice is duplicated. Runs entirely on this machine — the file is read and written locally and never sent anywhere.

force.description: Replace the output file if it already exists

output.description: Path to write the organized PDF

pages.description: Pages to KEEP, in the order wanted, 1-based. e.g. "3,1,5-8". Order matters; repeat a number to duplicate that page.

name: pdf_organize
title: Organize PDF pages
